verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 7 258V is a laptop processor, a hardware product with no web service whose HTTP API could be described by an OpenAPI or equivalent spec, so this story is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip itself ships a machine-readable API spec: the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and the SDK mentions (oneAPI, OpenVINO) are separate developer toolkits, not a downloadable API spec for this product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
